status_summary: No rule or guidance matching the noncash benefit definition, the reporting clarification or the marriage and family formation measurement was found. ACF's TANF rulemaking in the period implements Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 changes: a proposed rule published 2026-04-06 resets the caseload reduction credit base year and excludes small separate-state-program checks from work participation rates, and a 2026-07-31 final rule removes obsolete AFDC-era and TANF regulations. Neither was found to address the items in the recommendation.
